flow: Manual template → Evaluate Email → Change Difficulty → Least difficult
purpose: Exercise the acceptance/rejection loop, guardrails, and route progress toward Many + Weak.

generation_context.organization_context: Finance staff routinely receive portal review assignments.

evaluation_context.situation_context: Finance staff are currently performing normal document reviews.

change_difficulty.feedback: Keep the same document-review scenario and keep the message realistic.

steps: Paste and evaluate the supplied realistic email.
Choose Least difficult, Max iterations 3, and use the provided feedback.
Run the agent and inspect accepted revisions/status.
Do not apply until the preview has been checked.
expected_invariants: Agent attempts to move toward an easier-to-detect NIST route.
Worse candidates may be rejected instead of replacing the current best email.
The result may correctly end as not_reached if fixed context prevents the target.
No 'phishing simulation', 'do not click', 'verify sender', or similar meta-disclosure appears.
No expected legitimate domain/sender is leaked into the email unless it was already present.
No new hardcoded http/https URL is invented.
